As we all know, we have a draft notification package related to the cloud security incident that needs to be approved this week, including the regulatory filing and customer notices. Before I can give final approval, our incident-response protocol requires that the responsible counsel from each participating function report their relevant findings. Let's start hearing from each of you.

I've confirmed that exactly 2,736 accounts had both names and email addresses exposed together with unencrypted Social Security numbers. This updated count needs to be reflected in the notification package before it's approved.
